text:
Clare (PM): Heads up — prepping a release for the next change window (Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC). Posting a tight internal blurb + rollout checklist here. Need quick reviews on pinned versions, rollback criteria, and deploy-bot cues. @Mike (Eng) @Sylvia SRE can you confirm canary lanes and oncall?

Mike (Eng): Quick pass — canary plan: Canary-A (eu-west) -> Canary-B (us-west) -> Global. Will pin hosted model to v1.12.3 and set dedicated fallback to v1.12.3-quant.

Jaspreet: Add a one-liner about expected cost delta please (small uptick from caching change).

Clare (PM): Good call. Adding cost note in the blurb. Draft below — please only suggest edits to the copy.

Clare (PM): ```
Internal release (change window): 2026-03-25 02:00-04:00 UTC
Highlights: improved prefix/KV caching, reduce tail latency and token spend for multi-turn chats
Client impact: transient canaries; most customers see no interruption. Expect ~3-5% token cost reduction for cacheable workloads (some short-lived spike during rollout).
Pinned versions: hosted: redwood/model:v1.12.3
Dedicated fallback: redwood/model:v1.12.3-quant (auto fallback on resource pressure)
Rollback criteria: automatic fallback to quantized variant on node OOMs; manual rollback if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m OR p50 latency increases by 50% across any production route for 5m.
Deploy sequence: deploy-bot schedule -> Canary-A -> Canary-B -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% -> monitor 15m between waves
Oncall: primary @Alyssa (oncall), backup @Sylvia SRE
Runbooks: see https://internal.redwood/release/runbooks/cache-v1.12.3
```

Sylvia SRE: Fine from infra side. I'll wire deploy-bot hooks and add canary health checks (5xx, p50/p95 latency, KV miss rate). Suggest adding an emergency evacuation step: if canary triggers, immediate pause + revert traffic to previous model image while we investigate.

Mike (Eng): Agree with evacuation step. Also setting throttles so we don't spike cost if caching misbehaves.

Alyssa (oncall): I'll be awake for the window. If deploy-bot posts a pause I'll take the lead. Please DM pager if rollback initiated.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout queued: 2026-03-25T02:05:00Z -> Canary-A. Playbook: https://deploybot.internal/jobs/3942

Clare (PM): Thanks team. Final asks before I publish internal announce: 1) confirm the short blurb version below is OK for staff digest, 2) let me know if anyone wants to add a NOTE about specific customers to pre-brief.

Clare (PM): short blurb for digest: "Release 1.12.3 scheduled Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC. Improves caching and median latency. Pinned to hosted: v1.12.3 with quantized fallback. Oncall: Alyssa. Rollback: auto fallback + manual rollback criteria."

Mike (Eng): +1

Sylvia SRE: +1, add the evacuation line: "If canary fails, traffic will be paused and reverted to previous image."

Jaspreet: +1 on blurb, add cost note: "Net token cost reduction expected for cacheable workloads; small transient variance during rollout."

Clare (PM): Incorporating both. I'll post internal announcement in #general and pin in #eng-releases 30m prior to window. I'll also attach the runbook link. If no objections by EOD I'll send. :rocket:

Alyssa (oncall): Sounds good, thanks.

Mike (Eng): One more: tagging ops slack webhook to notify seeding customers during canary.

Clare (PM): Done. Closing thread; will post final announce with the blurb and runbook link at 2026-03-25 01:30 UTC.
